Name: Kyojinsukai
Information:
**Kyojinsukai**

The kyojinsukai are a rare, disastrous form of yokai who embodies the fear and weakness felt by mortals in regard to natural disasters. Most often caused by the unrest of communities caught in cataclysmic earthquakes or volcanic eruptions, the kyojinsukai appears as monolithic as such a disaster feels. It towers over cities and towns, unleashing similar disasters merely by being present. It is one of the most efficient yokai when feeding, as the disasters it causes directly reproduce the ire and disdain that give it form.

In exolunar colonies, there is a general fear that the systems keeping colonies in place could fail. On rare occasions, this fear can draw a kyojinsukai’s attention, who may then deliver such a fate to the colony.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yokai uses its Smokespear then makes two Devastation Claw attacks.

actions.name: Devastation Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (4d12 + 9) slashing damage.

actions.name: Smokespear
actions.description: The yokai conjures a spear of flame and smoke which falls on a point it can see within 240 feet. Each non-yokai creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered there must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: End of Days (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The yokai produces the effects of any of the following spells (which do not count as spells or magical effects for it), using Charisma as its spellcasting ability; the yokai is unaffected by any effects produced this way: earthquake, meteor swarm, or tsunami. If it chooses to use meteor swarm, it must recharge this feature twice successfully to regain its use. This ability can’t recharge while the yokai is concentrating on one of these effects.

legendary_actions.name: Hand of Destruction
legendary_actions.description: The yokai makes a Devastation Claw attack, which it does not apply its Massive trait to.

legendary_actions.name: Fearful Relinquish (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Each creature that is concentrating and can see or hear the yokai must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw, or lose concentration automatically.

legendary_actions.name: Quelling Life Scream (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The yokai unleashes a wave of sound and force, making each creature within 60 feet make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. Any target who fails is deafened and takes 18 (4d8) thunder damage. Creatures deafened this way repeat the save at the start of each of their turns, regaining their hearing on a success.

legendary_reactions.source_conversion_note: Converted from Legendary Resistance (3/Day) per standing formatting rule.
